production_model.name: all-mpnet-base-v2 fine-tuned with combined CoSENT + CosineSimilarity loss, + Platt calibration fitted on external calibration split
production_model.calibrator_choice_note: Platt and isotonic are statistically tied on the 106-pair test (delta MAE ~0.002, inside bootstrap noise and run-to-run training variance). Platt ships: a 2-parameter sigmoid cannot overfit a 106-pair calibration split, while isotonic's step function fits the calibration set tighter than it generalizes.

claude_opus_4_5_external_final_test_106_.setup: Same 106-pair external final test (stratified split, seed 42) as the fine-tuned model. Scored with the production system+user prompt and schema-constrained JSON output. One call per pair, zero-shot, no extended thinking/effort (this Bedrock model rejects them) — a matched floor, not Claude's ceiling.
claude_opus_4_5_external_final_test_106_.takeaway: Calibrator fit on the 106 calibration pairs and applied to the untouched test pairs — same protocol as the fine-tuned model. Calibration is monotonic, so Spearman is ~unchanged while MAE drops from 0.25 to 0.16: most of Claude's absolute-error gap was calibration, not judgment. The fine-tuned model still leads on both ranking (0.865 vs 0.71) and calibrated error (0.102 vs 0.16). Reproduce: scripts/claude_benchmark.py + scripts/calibrate.py.
